name: Port & Corniche
hero_subtitle: Working harbour and evening promenade — the daily pulse of Al Hoceima’s bay.

overview.title: Where the town meets the water
overview.p1: Al Hoceima’s port and corniche show the working side of the bay: fishing boats, nets, landings and a promenade that fills when the heat drops.
overview.p2: It is not a monumental old medina; it is a lived-in seafront. That is the point — cafés, views and a sense of local rhythm.
overview.p3: Start or end beach days here. Boat trips into park coves often leave from the harbour area.

q1.question: Is the port touristy?
q1.answer: It is a working harbour first — interesting for atmosphere more than monuments.

q2.question: Where to walk?
q2.answer: Along the corniche toward open bay views, especially at sunset.

q3.question: Fish restaurants?
q3.answer: Yes near the port and centre — ask for the day’s catch.

q4.question: Safe at night?
q4.answer: Stick to main lit stretches; usual town precautions apply.

q5.question: Boat trips?
q5.answer: Short coastal trips are often arranged from the port — confirm price and duration before boarding.
